example-letter.typ

A conformance sample for the Typst implementation — letter, ragged right, page-foot footnote. Rendered below from typeset.typ; the checker compiles it fresh on every commit.

The rendered pages are not available here — the source is below. To build them in a checkout, run node tools/build-previews.mjs with Typst on PATH.

49 lines · 1.6 KB

1// A conformance check for the letter template. Ragged right, no running head,
2// no folio, and a real footnote at the foot of the page.
3#import "typeset.typ": *
4
5#show: letter-page // ragged right, no running head, no folio
6
7#letter-sender[
8 Adilson Carvalho \
9 10 Wentworth Avenue \
10 Surry Hills NSW 2010 \
11 Australia
12]
13
14#letter-address-block(label: [To])[
15 The Registrar \
16 Institute of Typographic Studies \
17 88 Rundle Street \
18 Adelaide SA 5000
19]
20
2127 August 2026
22#letter-date-note[St Monica, mother of St Augustine Bishop, ora pro nobis]
23
24Dear Registrar,
25
26I am writing about the setting of the Institute's annual report, which arrived
27this morning and which I read with rather more attention to its margins than to
28its contents. I hope that is taken in the spirit intended.
29
30The text column runs to something near a hundred and ten
31characters.#footnote[Measured on page four, between the outer margins: 168mm at
32a 10pt body, which is about 112 characters.] By the second page I had lost my
33place twice, and by the fourth I had stopped reading and started measuring.
34
35This is a cheap problem to fix. Narrowing the column to sixty-six characters
36costs one afternoon and no money, and the space it frees on the right can carry
37the marginal notes that are currently crowded into footnotes.
38
39If it would be useful, I am glad to set one section of next year's report as a
40demonstration.
41
42Yours sincerely,
43
44#letter-signature[Adilson Carvalho]
45
46#letter-enclosures[typeset.css; two specimen pages]
47
48#letter-postscript[The tables were excellent — tabular figures throughout, which is
49more than most annual reports manage.]
